dashboards.name: Zillow Home Value Index (April 2019)
dashboards.description: Median U.S. home values by region, with inventory and rent-index (ZRI) tabs.
exampleQuestions: What is the ZHVI (median home value) for Boston, MA according to the dashboard?
Switch to the ZRI dashboard tab and report the current Zillow Rent Index (ZRI) value shown for the United States.

dashboards.name: California Infectious Diseases
dashboards.description: Reported infectious disease cases across California, filterable by year and sex.
exampleQuestions: Filter the dashboard to show only Male cases (keep the year at its default). Which disease appears to have the most reported case icons for males?

dashboards.name: Over the Hill (US Demographics)
dashboards.description: What share of Americans are older than a given age — U.S. age demographics by gender.
exampleQuestions: Set the gender filter to Female. What percentage of Female Americans are older than the currently displayed age?

dashboards.name: California Revenue Sources
dashboards.description: California state revenue sources over time, with a fiscal-year range filter.
exampleQuestions: Narrow the FY Ending date range to 1990 through 2000 and describe what happened to total California revenue over that period.

dashboards.name: Redfin Existing Home Sales
dashboards.description: U.S. existing home sales: annualized rate, MoM/YoY metrics, seasonal adjustment toggle.
exampleQuestions: What is the most recent Home Sales Annualized Rate for the National region (seasonally adjusted), according to the dashboard?
Change the Metrics parameter to 'Home Sales YoY' and report the most recent value shown.
